text:
PMATH 433: Model Theory
Description: Definable sets, quantifier elimination, algebraically closed fields, real closed fields, omitting types and prime models, interpretation and imaginaries, types, saturation, strongly minimal sets and the Zilber trichotomy, forking, and independence.
Requirements: Prereq: PMATH 432
